problem_statement:
Make creating streams faster in large organizations
In large organizations (like chat.zulip.org), creating a stream can be very slow (seconds to tens of seconds). We should fix this.

It should be possible to reproduce this by creating 20K users with `manage.py populate_db --extra-users` in a development environment.
